description: Get the status and details of an e-commerce order. Supports Salla and Zid platforms, and any other connected store that can look orders up (odoo, shopify, woocommerce). Orders are synced from the connected store.

platform.description: E-commerce platform: salla, zid or odoo, shopify, woocommerce. If not specified, searches every connected store.

name: get_order_status
